title: List project documentation files
task_brief: Use file_commands to navigate to /workspace and list all markdown (.md) files in the directory to create an inventory of documentation.

title: Check workspace disk usage
task_brief: Use file_commands to check the disk usage of the /workspace directory and identify which subdirectories consume the most space.

title: Verify internet connectivity
task_brief: Use network_commands to ping a public DNS server (like 8.8.8.8) and confirm that the workspace has internet connectivity.

title: Find all Python files
task_brief: Use file_commands to recursively search /workspace for all Python (.py) files and output their paths to understand the project structure.

title: Monitor active processes
task_brief: Use process_commands to list all currently running processes and identify the top 5 processes by memory usage.

title: Extract TODO comments from code
task_brief: Use data_commands to search all source files in /workspace for lines containing 'TODO' comments and compile them into a list.

title: Create project directory structure
task_brief: Use file_commands to create a standard project structure with folders: /workspace/src, /workspace/tests, /workspace/docs, and /workspace/config.

title: Count lines of code
task_brief: Use data_commands to count the total number of lines across all Python files in /workspace to measure project size.

title: Check network port availability
task_brief: Use network_commands to check if common development ports (3000, 8000, 8080) are currently in use or available.

title: Archive old log files
task_brief: Use file_commands to find all .log files in /workspace older than 30 days and move them to an /workspace/archive directory.

title: Generate file inventory report
task_brief: Use file_commands and data_commands to create a CSV report listing all files in /workspace with their sizes and last modified dates.

title: Find duplicate file names
task_brief: Use file_commands and data_commands to identify any duplicate file names (regardless of path) within /workspace that might cause confusion.

title: Monitor CPU usage over time
task_brief: Use process_commands and script_execution to create a simple monitoring script that samples CPU usage every 5 seconds for 1 minute.

title: Extract email addresses from files
task_brief: Use data_commands to search through all text files in /workspace and extract any email addresses found, removing duplicates.

title: Verify file permissions
task_brief: Use file_commands to check that all shell scripts (.sh files) in /workspace have execute permissions and report any that don't.

title: Test DNS resolution
task_brief: Use network_commands to verify that common domain names (google.com, github.com) resolve correctly from the workspace environment.

title: Create backup script
task_brief: Use script_execution and file_commands to create a simple backup script that copies all .md files to a /workspace/backup directory.

title: Find large files
task_brief: Use file_commands to identify all files in /workspace larger than 10MB and list them sorted by size.

title: Parse configuration files
task_brief: Use data_commands to extract all key-value pairs from .env or .config files in /workspace and display them in a readable format.

title: Check for running web servers
task_brief: Use process_commands to identify if any web server processes (nginx, apache, node) are currently running in the workspace.

title: Organize files by extension
task_brief: Use file_commands and data_commands to count how many files of each type (.py, .js, .md, etc.) exist in /workspace and create a summary report.

title: Clean temporary files
task_brief: Use file_commands to find and remove all temporary files (.tmp, .cache, .swp) from /workspace to free up space.

title: Validate JSON files
task_brief: Use data_commands to check all .json files in /workspace for syntax errors and report which files are valid or invalid.

title: Network latency test
task_brief: Use network_commands to measure network latency to multiple servers and identify the one with the lowest response time.

title: Create file tree visualization
task_brief: Use file_commands to generate a tree-style visualization of the /workspace directory structure up to 3 levels deep.

title: Extract import statements
task_brief: Use data_commands to find all import/require statements in Python or JavaScript files and create a dependency list.

title: Monitor memory usage
task_brief: Use process_commands to check current system memory usage and identify if any processes are consuming excessive RAM.

title: Batch rename files
task_brief: Use file_commands and script_execution to rename all files in a specific directory by adding a timestamp prefix to each filename.

title: Find empty directories
task_brief: Use file_commands to locate all empty directories within /workspace that could be cleaned up or removed.

title: Check network interfaces
task_brief: Use network_commands to list all network interfaces and display their IP addresses and status.

title: Create automated cleanup script
task_brief: Use script_execution, file_commands, and data_commands to create a script that removes files older than 90 days and logs the cleanup actions.

title: Search for hardcoded credentials
task_brief: Use data_commands to scan source files for common patterns that might indicate hardcoded passwords or API keys (like 'password=', 'api_key=').

title: Compare directory contents
task_brief: Use file_commands and data_commands to compare two directories in /workspace and identify files that exist in one but not the other.

title: Kill idle processes
task_brief: Use process_commands to identify processes that have been idle for more than 1 hour and terminate them to free resources.

title: Generate project statistics
task_brief: Use file_commands, data_commands, and script_execution to create a comprehensive report showing total files, total lines of code, file type distribution, and last modified dates.
